concept_families.name: Identity
concept_families.purpose: Canonical identity-bearing actor or system identity.

concept_families.name: Delegation
concept_families.purpose: Time- and scope-bound delegation of authority.

concept_families.name: Policy
concept_families.purpose: Rules governing permitted and required behavior.

concept_families.name: Capability
concept_families.purpose: Discoverable system capability independent of authority.

concept_families.name: Domain
concept_families.purpose: Composable functional domain independent of organization units.

concept_families.name: Work
concept_families.purpose: Work items, assignments, actions, and work state.

concept_families.name: Decision
concept_families.purpose: Human or authorized institutional decision object.

concept_families.name: Evidence
concept_families.purpose: Evidence, source, provenance, and result structures.

concept_families.name: Agent
concept_families.purpose: AI agent identity, capabilities, scope, and supervision.

concept_families.name: Change
concept_families.purpose: Governed system change, verification, and acceptance.

invariants.description: Identity and Role are structurally distinct concepts.
Role assignment does not itself constitute authority.
Technical capability does not create institutional authority.
Evidence may support a decision but is not itself a decision.
AI recommendation must not be represented as Human decision.
Domain definitions must not be hard-coded to organization structure.
Current state must not replace lifecycle history or provenance.
Registry-governed configuration must not depend on source-code hard-coding.

versioning.compatibility_policy: Breaking canonical contract changes require a major version.
versioning.reference_policy: References identify targets explicitly and may constrain compatible versions.
